measures.name: SVG Card Sales
measures.expression: VAR d = [Sales ΔPY] VAR c = IF ( d > 0, "#8CB400", "#D00000" ) RETURN "data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><text fill='" & c & "'>" & FORMAT ( d, "+0.0;-0.0;0.0" ) & "</text><rect fill='#404040'/></svg>"

measures.name: SVG Pin Length
measures.expression: VAR w = ABS ( [Sales ΔPY%] ) * 100 RETURN "<svg><rect width='" & w & "' fill='#404040'/></svg>"

measures.name: Sales ΔPY% Guarded
measures.expression: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Sales] ) && [Sales PY] > 0, DIVIDE ( [Sales] - [Sales PY], [Sales PY] ) )
